blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT helps every Czarnikow office. It works for London and for São Paulo. When your computer is slow or broken, you call the help desk. They listen and they help.

In this lesson you learn simple English. You learn the words you need to talk to IT. You also learn the words you need for an online meeting.

Today you learn five useful words. You practise them in short sentences. Go slow — one step at a time. You can do it!

items.q: Which offices does IT help?
items.why: "IT helps every Czarnikow office." — atende todos os escritórios.

items.q: What do you call when your computer is broken?
items.why: "you call the help desk" — é o suporte de TI.

items.q: How many useful words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words."

items.q: "Go slow — one step at a time." This suggests the lesson wants you to…
items.why: Inferência: "go slow, one step at a time" pede calma, não pressa.

items.q: The text would most likely AGREE that…
options: you cannot talk to IT in English
simple English is enough to talk to the help desk
these words are only for London
items.why: Inferência: a lição ensina inglês simples justamente para falar com a TI e em reuniões.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James no help desk. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, this is James from IT. How can I help you today?

Okay. Your computer is slow. I understand. When did it start? This morning? Good, thank you. Please close all the programs first. Now, restart the computer. We do this first, always. Many small problems go away after a restart.

And the screen? Is it dark, or can you see it? Dark. Okay, no problem. Please check the power. Is the cable in? Push it in. Yes? Good. Is there a light on the screen now?

Now the video call. You say it is frozen. That is a common problem. Please leave the meeting and join again. Slow internet can do this. It is not your computer.

One more thing. Is any file broken? A file that does not open? No? That is good news. Your files are safe.

So, three small steps: restart the computer, check the screen, and join the call again. Try them now, slowly, one at a time. If it is still bad, call me back. I am here all day. We are a small team, but we are fast and we like to help. Thank you, and have a good day!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "Hi, this is James from IT."

items.q: What is the first thing James asks the user to do for the slow computer?
items.why: "close all the programs. Now, restart the computer. We do this first, always."

items.q: The video call is frozen. What does James say to do?
options: Leave the meeting and join again
items.why: "Please leave the meeting and join again."

items.q: James asks about the screen and the cable. This suggests that a dark screen…
options: can be a simple power problem
items.why: Inferência: ele manda checar o cabo e a energia, ou seja, a tela escura pode ser só falta de energia.

items.q: How would you describe James's attitude?
items.why: Inferência: ele explica passo a passo, agradece e diz que fica o dia todo — é calmo e prestativo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My computer is very slow today." Slow means…
options: not fast; it takes a long time
items.why: Slow = lento; demora para responder.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The printer does not work. It is ___."
items.why: Broken = quebrado; a impressora não funciona.

items.q: "The video call is frozen." Frozen means the screen…
options: does not move; it is stuck
items.why: Frozen = travado; a imagem para e não se move.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I turn on the computer, but the screen is ___. I see nothing."
items.why: Dark = escuro; a tela não mostra nada.

items.q: "The internet is bad today." Bad means…
items.why: Bad = ruim; de baixa qualidade.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem quando você fala com a TI. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please restart your computer." To restart means to…
options: turn it off and on again
items.why: Restart = reiniciar: desligar e ligar de novo.

items.q: "I can't log in to my email." To log in means to…
options: enter with your name and password
items.why: Log in = entrar (fazer login) com usuário e senha.

items.q: "Please turn off the computer before you go home." To turn off means to…
options: stop it; make it not work
items.why: Turn off = desligar.

items.q: "Don't worry, IT will sort out the problem." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, dar um jeito no problema.

items.q: "Please back up your files every week." To back up means to…
options: send your files to a client
make a safe copy of your files
items.why: Back up = fazer cópia de segurança (backup).
